name: MilesWeb
tagline: Budget cPanel hosting from India with NVMe storage and a free domain
description: MilesWeb is an India-based web host offering cPanel shared, reseller and VPS hosting with NVMe storage, popular across the India/APAC market.
about: MilesWeb is an Indian web hosting provider built around the industry-standard cPanel control panel, aimed squarely at the India/APAC market with INR pricing and local data-center options alongside international ones.

Shared hosting comes in four tiers: Starter (1 website, 10GB NVMe storage), Premium (25 websites, 50GB NVMe storage), Business (50 websites, 100GB NVMe storage), and Cloud Startup (100 websites, 150GB NVMe storage). All four run on cPanel and include a free domain for the first year plus a free SSL certificate.

Introductory pricing starts at ₹69/month (Starter), ₹99/month (Premium), ₹149/month (Business) and ₹299/month (Cloud Startup) — but each plan renews at a noticeably higher rate once the promotional term ends: ₹399, ₹499, ₹699 and ₹1,499 per month respectively. Check the renewal price before locking into a long upfront term for the lowest headline rate.
policies: MilesWeb backs its hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, letting new customers request a refund if the service isn't a fit within that window.
